meta: What does AI do in hospitals? It helps read X-rays and write draft notes, but it can still miss things, so the doctor signs the final conclusion.

muc.title: AI reading X-rays
muc.text: AI already helps read X-rays in many hospitals, but the person who signs the final conclusion is still the doctor.

muc.title: AI circles suspicious spots
muc.text: AI looks at thousands of scans a day without getting tired, and circles suspicious spots so the doctor checks them first.

muc.title: AI takes notes for the doctor
muc.text: Some places also use AI to listen to the appointment and write a draft medical record, so the doctor looks at the patient instead of the screen.

muc.title: AI can miss things too
muc.text: But AI learns from data from other places, so with an unusual case it can still miss something. A doctor always needs to check again.

muc.title: Use AI to get more from your visit
muc.text: When you ask a chatbot about symptoms, don't ask for a diagnosis. Ask it to list the questions you should ask the doctor at your appointment.
